name: Iron
description: Composed mainly of iron-nickel metal from the cores of shattered asteroids.

name: Stony
description: The most common meteorite type, composed mostly of silicate minerals.

name: Chondrite
description: Non-differentiated stony meteorites containing small spheres called chondrules.

name: Achondrite
description: Stony meteorites without chondrules, formed by magmatic activity.

name: Pallasite
description: Stony-iron meteorites with olivine crystals embedded in metal.

name: Stony-Iron
description: A mix of metal and rock, excluding pallasites (e.g., Mesosiderites).

name: Martian
description: Rocks ejected from the surface of Mars by impacts.

name: Tektite
description: Natural glass objects formed by the impact of large meteorites on Earth.

name: Space Debris
description: Artificial material recovered from orbit or re-entry (satellite fragments, fuel).
